h: Burna Boy presents the Socrates Award to Bukayo Saka at the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London
p: Nigerian superstar Burna Boy handed the Socrates Award to Arsenal and England winger Bukayo Saka on stage at the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony in London. The moment drew warm reactions from football and music fans online.
more: The ceremony in London also crowned Harry Kane as the 2026 winner.
Saka was honoured for his work off the pitch.
